t: 已装饰的橡木尖桩篱栅！

The Picket Fence is a special decorative type of Fence block. It has a matching gate and comes in all Vanilla wood colors.$(br2)These pretty fences can be decorated with greenery and lights to spruce them up for the holidays.
尖桩篱栅是一种特殊的装饰性篱栅方块，配有匹配的栅门，并涵盖全部原版木材颜色。$(br2)这些美观的篱栅可通过绿植与灯具装饰，为节日增添氛围。
To decorate a Picket Fence, combine it with any type of Horizontal Garland in a crafting table. $(br2)The Picket Fence Gate can be combined with a wreath of your choice for decoration.
要装饰尖桩篱栅，请在工作台中将其与任意水平花环组合。$(br2)尖桩篱栅门则可与任选花环组合以作装饰。
